ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15-20% coverage of high-intensity (white) markings, creating a high-contrast pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white markings including circular punctate spots concentrated near the lower-medial regions and multiple linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude (3-10 pixel) peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep trajectory on the outer margins of both lobes, tapering to distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) consistent with barnacle scarring, located predominantly in the lower quadrants and along the medial boundaries of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) ranging from 20 to 150 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) on the leading edges of both lobes; prominent brown/tan parasitic or organismal cluster on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Large, distinctive brown cluster of biological matter attached to the extreme right trailing edge tip, distinct from pigmentation patterns.
